contentText:
“Build the Wall” was pulled days after the White House launched its “arcade.” | Screenshot: The Verge

The White House has taken down its racist Tetris ripoff days after launching a website dedicated to "arcade" games, as spotted earlier by Kotaku . The Tetris clone, called "Build the Wall," involved stacking different-sized blocks to prevent a "zombie border siege."

It's not clear why the White House removed the title, though the Tetris Company previously said that it's looking into the situation. "For more than 40 years, Tetris has brought people together across generations and cultures through play and joy," Tetris spokesperson Kerri Brusca told The Verge last week .
